processing: Monthly area-weighted administrative summaries, with the native-pixel monthly temperature maximum separately identified. Road length is an independent static 2019 cartographic reference, not repeated into monthly observations.
limitations: Small communes may share native pixels; the data do not gain spatial resolution when grouped by commune.
Specific humidity is not relative humidity; soil moisture and soil temperature remain separate.
AOD is monthly MERRA-2, not MAIAC.
No daily records, pixels, cities, localities, custom radii or geometries are included in this compact delivery.
NASA POWER adds scalar wind speed at 10 m, relative humidity and monthly peak temperature directly from the provider. Monthly peaks are native-grid estimates, not exact local thermometer extremes.

Road length is supplied only as a 2019 cartographic reference, not a monthly historical reconstruction. The downloaded BCN urban archive was rejected because its lineage referenced a 2008 base; it was not relabeled as 2019 data.
Vegetation, fire, terrain and additional infrastructure datasets are outside the user-reduced scope, not completed downloads.

validation.tolerance_reason: Native float32 pixel centers are rounded by the prior CSV serialization; original validated regional values are retained.
